pairsWith.noteUz: 'can' jadvali grammar 10-bet Ex.5 ga, 'have got' jadvali grammar 9-bet Ex.2 ga, alifbo coursebook 16-bet Ex.16 (imlo) ga mos keladi.

scanNote.uz: Skanerlangan nusxada Ex.6, Ex.8 va Ex.9 TO'G'RI bajarilgan. Ex.5 ning davomida (4 va 5-band) xato bor — quyida izohlangan.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions and answers as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunadagidek savol va javob yozing (9-betdagi mashqning davomi).
exercises.explanationUz:
MUHIM FARQ — qaysi fe'l kerak?

  BE ishlatiladi:  bo'y, gavda, yosh, millat, kasb, holat
     'Are they tall?' · 'Is he Italian?'

  HAVE GOT ishlatiladi: soch, ko'z, burun, egalik
     'HAS HE GOT fair hair?' — 'Is he fair hair?' XATO!

Soch — bu odamning O'ZI emas, unda BOR narsa.
Shuning uchun 'have got' kerak.

items.question: Are they tall?
items.whyUz: Bo'y — sifat, demak BE. Javobda ega ('they're') tushib qolmasin.

commonMistake.whyUz:
EGA TUSHIB QOLGAN. Ingliz tilida ega majburiy: 'No, THEY'RE quite short.'
Va gap boshida katta harf: 'No'.

items.prompt: he / fair hair? → No / dark hair
items.question: Has he got fair hair?

commonMistake.wrong: 'is he fair hair?' / 'no, is'n dark hair'
commonMistake.whyUz:
Ikki jiddiy xato:
1) Soch uchun BE ishlatilmaydi. 'IS he fair hair' — XATO.
   To'g'risi: 'HAS HE GOT fair hair?'
2) Javobda ham: 'No, HE'S GOT dark hair.'
   'is'n' degan shakl umuman yo'q (isn't ham bu yerda mos emas).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table and fill in can or can't.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang va can yoki can't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Uch odam, olti qobiliyat. Jadvaldan ✓ yoki ✗ ni topib, mos shaklni qo'ying.

DIQQAT — 2-bandda UCHTA bo'shliq bor va ular ketma-ket:
  'Daniel CAN sing ... and he CAN use computers but he CAN'T play cricket.'
Birinchi ikkitasi 'and' bilan bog'langan (ikkalasi ham tasdiq),
uchinchisi 'but' dan keyin (inkor).

items.textEn: Kate ___ play cricket, but she ___ swim.
Daniel ___ sing very well and he ___ use computers but he ___ play cricket.
Ben ___ cook but he ___ play cricket.
Ben, Daniel and Kate ___ speak English.
Ben and Daniel ___ cook, but they ___ use computers.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table again. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qayta qarang. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Qolip: 'Can + ISM + FE'L?' → 'Yes, he/she can.' / 'No, he/she can't.'
Jadvaldagi 18 katakning har biri uchun savol tuzsa bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and repeat after your teacher.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ingliz alifbosi — 26 harf. Harflarning NOMI va TOVUSHI boshqa-boshqa!

O'zbek o'quvchilari uchun eng adashtiradigan harflar:
  A [ey]  — 'a' emas
  E [i:]  — 'e' emas
  I [ay]  — 'i' emas
  G [ji:] — 'g' emas
  J [jey] — 'j' emas
  H [eych]
  W [dabl-yu] — eng uzun nomli harf
  Y [way]

Bu bilim IMLO aytishda (coursebook 16-bet) kerak bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table and fill in has, hasn't, have or haven't.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang va has, hasn't, have yoki haven't dan mosini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — 'or' inkor gapda:
  'They haven't got a camera OR a computer.'
  Inkor gapda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi!

  Tasdiq: 'She has got a camera AND a TV.'
  Inkor:  'She hasn't got a camera OR a TV.'

Bu o'zbek o'quvchilari kam biladigan, lekin muhim qoida.

items.textEn: Jennifer ___ got a camera and a TV. She ___ got a computer.
Richard and Jennifer ___ got a mobile phone.
items.whyUz: Ikkalasida ham mobil telefon ✗ → ko'plik, inkor

items.textEn: Helen and Chris ___ got a camera or a computer, but they ___ got a TV and a mobile phone.
Richard ___ got a computer and a TV, but he ___ got a camera or a mobile phone.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table above. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi jadvalga qarang. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Qolip: 'Has/Have + EGA + got + a NARSA?' → 'Yes, EGA has/have.' / 'No, EGA hasn't/haven't.'
Qisqa javobda 'got' takrorlanmaydi.

items.question: Have Helen and Chris got a mobile phone?
Have Helen and Chris got a computer?
Has Richard got a mobile phone?

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
Javob TURI savolni aytib beradi:

  Joy nomi (Portugal, Spain) → Where ...?
  Millat (Italian)           → What's your nationality?
  Yosh (17)                  → How old ...?
  Yes/No                     → Are you ...?
  Rang (Red)                 → What's your favourite colour?
  Raqam (660068)             → What's your telephone number?
  Kasb (hairdresser)         → What's her job?

DIQQAT: 'Where are YOU from?' → 'I'm ...' · 'Where are YOU AND YOUR FRIEND from?' → 'WE'RE ...'
Savoldagi ega javobdagi egani belgilaydi.

pairs.left: 6. Are you in the school basketball team?
pairs.right: b. No, I'm in the school football team.

pairs.left: 12. Where are you and your friend from?

groups.explanationUz: Ex.9 dagi 'hairdresser' shu qoida bilan yasalgan.
Bu betdagi buyum va joy nomlari.
Harfning nomi bilan u beradigan tovush boshqa-boshqa. Imlo aytishda NOM ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Bu betdagi eng muhim qoida — inkor gapda 'or'.

patterns.formula: INKORDA 'or': EGA + hasn't/haven't got + A + or + B
patterns.exampleEn: They haven't got a camera or a computer.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularda kamera ham, kompyuter ham yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz:
INKOR gapda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi.
  'haven't got a camera OR a computer' — TO'G'RI
  'haven't got a camera AND a computer' — noto'g'ri
Tasdiq gapda esa 'and': 'has got a camera AND a TV'.

patterns.formula: BE yoki HAVE GOT — qaysi biri?
patterns.exampleEn: Are they tall? (bo'y) / Has he got fair hair? (soch)
patterns.exampleUz: Ular baland bo'ylimi? / Uning sochi oq-sariqmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
BE — odamning O'ZI qanaqa (bo'y, gavda, yosh, millat, kasb).
HAVE GOT — odamda NIMA BOR (soch, ko'z, burun, narsalar).

patterns.formula: EGA MAJBURIY: No, THEY'RE quite short.
patterns.exampleEn: Are they tall? — No, they're quite short.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular baland bo'ylimi? — Yo'q, ular ancha past.
patterns.explanationUz:
O'zbekchada 'Yo'q, past' desa bo'ladi. Inglizchada EGA tushib qolmaydi:
'No, THEY'RE quite short.'

patterns.exampleEn: Where are you from? → I'm ... · Where are you and your friend from? → We're ...
patterns.exampleUz: Qayerdansiz? → Men... · Siz va do'stingiz qayerdansiz? → Biz...
patterns.explanationUz: Savolda 'you' bitta odamga qaratilgan bo'lsa 'I', ikki kishiga bo'lsa 'we'.
